title: Sheinbaum Meets with Vietnam’s President; They Discuss Trade and APEC 2027
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
content:
_This article
by[Redacción/SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/)
originally appeared in the [November 17, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905629/sheinbaum-se-reune-con-el-
presidente-de-vietnam-conversan-sobre-comercio-y-apec-2027/), a Mexican
digital news outlet._

_The Mexican president will meet with President Donald Trump as part of her
activities in China._

**Mexico City, November 17 (SinEmbargo).-** President [**Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/claudia-sheinbaum/) met with her
Vietnamese counterpart **Tô Lâm** on her third day of activities in
**Shenzhen** , China, during her visit to Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
(**APEC**).

On social media, Mexico’s government shared images of the meeting between the
Mexican president and the general secretary of the **Communist Party of
Vietnam** , in which they discussed trade and the [**APEC
2027**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4904923/sigue-la-mananera-con-rosa-icela-
rodriguez-hoy-martes-17-de-noviembre-en-vivo/) summit, which will be held in
the Asian nation.

The meeting was scheduled for 10:45 a.m. on Wednesday, November 18, Shenzhen
time (8:45 p.m. on Tuesday, November 17, central Mexico time), as part of the
Mexican president’s second day of activities in China.

Afterward, the Mexican president will attend the APEC leaders’ photo session
and later meet with US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen, China.

> [Post by @GobiernoMX on
> X](https://x.com/GobiernoMX/status/2122913281874473160)

The head of the executive branch confirmed the meeting through a live link to
Tuesday’s morning press conference in Mexico City and emphasized that the
meeting with the US president would be brief.

“Tomorrow we will be with the president of Vietnam. Then we are going to visit
a hospital, a smart hospital, because we are very interested in having
collaboration with China on health issues as well, and that is why we are
going to visit it. Afterward, we are going to have a brief meeting with the
president of the United States,” she explained in the message broadcast at the
National Palace.

## Sheinbaum and Xi Jinping Usher in a “New Era” in Mexico-China Relations

President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo (CSP) said that her visit to China
represents “a new era in relations between Mexico and China,” following a
bilateral meeting with her Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, during the 33rd
Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting, being held
in Shenzhen.

During the meeting, the two leaders highlighted the importance of the bonds of
friendship between their countries and expressed their willingness to continue
strengthening them through the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, a
mechanism for political, diplomatic and economic understanding established in
2013.

![Claudia Sheinbaum and Xi Jinping shake hands in front of Mexican and Chinese
flags.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-
vietnam-trade-apec-inline-1.jpg)President Claudia Sheinbaum met with her
counterpart Xi Jinping. Photo: X @Claudiashein.

> “This visit represents a new era in relations between Mexico and China, a
> relationship that is the result of deep bonds of friendship and shared
> principles, such as cooperation for development and shared prosperity,”
> Sheinbaum Pardo said.

The head of the executive branch noted that Mexico and China have expanded
their areas of cooperation in different fields, including sargassum
mitigation, science and technology, infrastructure, agriculture, clean energy,
water resources, health, culture and tourism.
